name: HH breakout 06 — fakeout fade with realized-vol gate (30m)
rationale: MECHANISM: the same fakeout-fade thesis (most raw breakouts fail; extremes in a range regime revert), but on a 30m clock and with an EXPLICIT vol_realized CEILING instead of relying on bb_width alone — the distinct claim is that fades only pay when realized volatility is genuinely LOW (a calm range), because in a high-vol regime the 'extreme' is a real expansion, not a sweep. Enter LONG at the range-low extreme when vol_realized is below a fitted ceiling AND adx is low. The 30m clock trades fewer, higher-quality fades than 15m so fee drag is lower — a different frequency/regime cell from variants 04/05. Counterparty: breakdown-chasers whose stops are swept in the quiet range. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the vol_realized gate adds nothing over the plain range-extreme fade (removing it does not change the edge → the 'calm-only' claim is false), or if the reversion does not beat fees on a majority of symbols per-symbol, or if the edge only exists pre-2024 in the holdout. atr is carried for context/sizing but the vol gate is the load-bearing filter.
catalyst: range-low sweep in a demonstrably calm (low realized-vol) regime
